newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway bonds end mixed, crown firming.
newsitem.headline: Norway bonds end mixed, crown firming.

text.p: 1400 GMT -- Norwegian bonds ended mixed in modest trade with many big players being away on the year's last market day.

Norwegian 10-year bonds were flat, but short rates were up after the central bank announced a 12-billion crown expansion of the SS42 treasury bill that was bigger than the market had expected, a dealer said.
"The volume was proportionally high. This is a signal that the central bank is resisting a possible rate cut," the dealer added.
The crown firmed to at 100.95 on the inverse ECU index.
* Norway over bunds gap unchanged at 46 points
* Three-month eurokrone 22 basis points higher at 3.95 pct
